project_info.theme: Premium protein preorder poster with flavour lineup and free add-on
project_info.color_palette: Cream, Ultimate Sup Yellow, Black, White, Chocolate Brown, Fruit Accent Colors

main_subject.detail: A large REF_HERO_PRODUCT_LINEUP sits on a yellow branded plinth beneath an oversized {{PREORDER_HEADLINE}}, with flavour cues around the packs and a white lower offer band for {{BUY_GET_HEADLINE}} plus REF_FREE_GIFT_PRODUCT.
main_subject.style: Premium protein retail hero, realistic black tub packshots, bold sale typography

composition_elements.type: Protein packshots / flavour props / offer panel
items: Top: Oversized preorder headline and compact flavour subhead.
Center: REF_HERO_PRODUCT_LINEUP in varied sizes/flavours on a yellow plinth patterned with subtle REF_BRAND_LOGO marks.
Side accents: REF_FLAVOUR_PROPS such as cookie, fruit, chocolate, vanilla, or cream splashes matching the actual SKU flavours.
Bottom Left: Buy/get mechanics and the main eligible product.
Bottom Center/Right: REF_FREE_GIFT_PRODUCT with a plus icon, gift burst, date window, limited-gift tag, and CTA.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Glossy tub highlights, creamy white swirls, flavour splashes, clean yellow retail energy

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: Create a square Ultimate Sup preorder poster for REF_HERO_PRODUCT_LINEUP. Use {{PREORDER_HEADLINE}} at the top, arrange flavour-correct product tubs on a yellow branded plinth, add matching REF_FLAVOUR_PROPS around the lineup, and reserve the bottom white band for {{BUY_GET_HEADLINE}}, REF_FREE_GIFT_PRODUCT, {{GIFT_DESCRIPTION}}, {{DATE_WINDOW}}, and {{CTA}}. Keep the product labels and logo references accurate, with a premium cream/yellow/black composition.
prompt.negative_prompt: wrong flavour cue, distorted tubs, wrong label, unapproved buy-get terms, generic protein containers, messy splashes over text, watermark, cropped CTA
